Prerequisite(s): Burmecian, 5 ranks in Acrobatics

Benefit: When using the Acrobatics skill to jump, you are always considered to have a running start and you add your character level to the check result. Whenever you deliberately fall, a successful DC 15 Acrobatics check allows you to ignore the first 20 feet fallen. For every 5 by which you exceed the DC of this check, you can ignore an additional 10 feet of distance fallen.
